_comment: Synthetic. Desktop app persisted tab state: ~/Library/Application Support/ai.opencode.desktop/drafts.sqlite, table state(name,key,value,updated_at), name='opencode.window.<windowUUID>.dat'. Values are JSON (possibly JSON-encoded strings). serverKey 'sidecar' = the background service; route key = serverKey + '\n' + '/server/' + base64url(serverKey) + '/session/' + sessionID. Persisted, so it survives window close/app quit: shows tabs, not proof of visibility.
